correctness.rationale: For d≥3, support-plane intersection norm² equals Haar frame sum of f=h². Orthogonal equator averaging multiplies degree 2m spherical harmonics by the displayed Gegenbauer product. Parseval and covariance yield exact variance multipliers. Ratio a_{m+1}/a_m=(2m+1)/(d+2m-1)<1; degrees 6/4 give sharp lower/upper. Smooth support examples sqrt(1+eps Y_6/Y_4) exist by curvature-radius positivity. Exact degree-2 kernel and positive f imply zero variance only for ellipsoids. Checked rational three-dimensional moments and reproducible seeded diagnostics; no enumeration treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Quantifies how a natural orthogonal-support construction detects nonspherical quadrupole-free shape distortions in every dimension. Gives optimal uniform stability conditioning, exact extremizing harmonic families, geometric smooth strictly convex realizations, and explicit regression quadratic; the mere classical ellipsoid characterization is not offered as new. It is a structural spectral stability theorem rather than a finite numerical refinement.
